# Brightfront

> Brightfront is a digital marketing agency in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia (ABN 80 241 124 181), founded and run by Roxanne Alterio. It runs search, paid media, social and email as one system rather than as separate line items, for established small and mid-sized businesses. Fixed monthly fees, no percentage of ad spend, no lock-in contract.

Tagline: We build brands and scale revenue with sharper digital marketing.

## Who it is for

Established businesses that have outgrown doing their own marketing: the ads are running but nobody can say what they return, the website gets traffic that does not convert, and social, email and search are each handled by someone different. Above roughly fifty thousand dollars a month in media spend a large agency will serve them better. Below that, they get more attention here.

## Services

- Google Ads: search, Performance Max and remarketing campaigns built and managed against revenue rather than clicks.
- Meta and Instagram advertising: paid social creative, audience building and structured testing across Facebook and Instagram.
- Search engine optimisation: technical SEO, content and local search, so the business is found without paying for every click.
- Social media management: organic content planned, produced and published so the brand stays visible between campaigns.
- Email and SMS marketing: Klaviyo and Mailchimp flows that turn one-time buyers into repeat revenue.
- Conversion and analytics: landing pages, tracking and reporting so every dollar of spend is attributed to a result.

Platforms worked in: Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, Meta Ads, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Shopify, WordPress.

## Performance guarantee

For businesses already running profitable Google or Facebook ads, Brightfront designs a new funnel, writes the ads and optimises performance until it beats the client's existing conversion rate, cost per lead or ROAS by 40% within 90 days. If it has not, Brightfront keeps working at no charge until it does. The 40% baseline is the client's own last 90 days of performance, agreed in writing before the engagement starts and measured in the client's own accounts.

## How engagements work

1. A free fifteen-minute call. The current website, search presence and social are reviewed beforehand, and the call covers what would change first.
2. A written plan and a fixed monthly fee, usually within one business day. Pricing is quoted per business and is not published.
3. Tracking, accounts and measurement set up before any spend goes out.
4. Campaigns live, then reported monthly in dollars: spend in, revenue or qualified enquiries out.
5. Thirty days' notice to stop, in writing. No exit fees, no minimum term.

## Commercial terms

- Fixed monthly fee, agreed in writing before work starts.
- The fee does not change with ad spend. Brightfront never takes a percentage of spend and never marks it up.
- The client's own card sits on their own Google and Meta accounts, so those platforms bill them directly.
- Every account, Google Ads, Meta Business, Analytics, the domain and the hosting, is in the client's name from day one. If the relationship ends, the client keeps all of it with the history intact.
- No lock-in contract. Thirty days' notice.

## Realistic timeframes

Paid media moves in weeks. SEO takes months. Brightfront does not promise a specific number by a specific date. Within the first month a client has a plan, tracking configured and campaigns live.

## Areas served

Based in Brisbane, Queensland. Works with businesses across Brisbane, the Gold Coast, Queensland and the rest of Australia, and remotely elsewhere.
